name: nines
install: python3 -m venv /workspace/.venv && /workspace/.venv/bin/pip install -U pip setuptools wheel && if [ -f pyproject.toml ]; then /workspace/.venv/bin/pip install -e ".[dev]"; else /workspace/.venv/bin/pip install pytest pytest-asyncio hypothesis anthropic httpx hatchling; fi && /workspace/.venv/bin/python --version && gh --version && echo 'export PATH=/workspace/.venv/bin:$PATH' >> ~/.bashrc
